annualLimits.answer: No. Billing may be annual, but usage limits for messages, audio, and AI services reset monthly. Unused capacity does not roll over.
annualLimits.question: Do annual plan limits accumulate throughout the year?

answerAccuracy.answer: No. Answers are generated automatically and may contain errors or omissions. You can review sources, extracted data, and profile readiness before publishing.

answerSources.answer: The AI uses information you configure and approve, including the description, experience, projects, education, skills, imported sources, social networks, selected media, and published products.

avatarAndVoice.answer: Open Profiles and select the presence you want to configure. Under Avatar, upload a JPG, PNG, or WEBP image, adjust the crop, and save it; once processing finishes, select the generated avatar. Then open Voice, choose the language, and select Clone your voice. Find a quiet place, read the complete guided text naturally, review the recording, and save the sample. Finally, test the clone of your own voice and enable it for the profile. Only use your own image and voice, or material you are expressly authorized to use.

audience.answer: It is designed for professionals, creators, educators, public figures, entrepreneurs, and personal brands that want to present their information and answer questions interactively.
audience.question: Who is Bigmelo for?

cancelRenewal.answer: Yes. You can cancel renewal from Billing. You will keep access until the end of the paid period or trial, and the next automatic charge will not be made.
cancelRenewal.question: Can I cancel automatic renewal?

cardData.answer: No. Sensitive card information is sent directly to Wompi. Bigmelo only keeps the information needed to identify and manage the payment method, such as the brand and last four digits.
cardData.question: Does Bigmelo store my full card details?

createPresence.answer: Create your account, select a plan or start the trial, configure the profile, add sources with relevant data, create the avatar and clone your own voice, review content quality, and publish your link.

dataDeletion.answer: Yes. You can unpublish the profile and request deletion of your account, profiles, images, audio, voice, conversations, products, and integrations by writing to privacy@bigmelo.com.
dataDeletion.question: Can I hide my profile or delete my data?

imageAndVoiceAuthorization.answer: You must use your own image and voice, or have the person's express authorization. Using a third party's image or voice without consent is not allowed.
imageAndVoiceAuthorization.question: What do I need to create the avatar and clone a voice?

limits.answer: Some features can continue using additional credits. If neither plan capacity nor credits are available, the affected feature is limited; for example, audio may be disabled or a reply may continue as text only.
limits.question: What happens when I reach a monthly limit?

missingInformation.answer: The profile is designed to recognize when the available information is insufficient and say that it does not know, instead of presenting missing information as fact.
missingInformation.question: What happens when it does not have enough information to answer?

plans.answer: Monthly and annual Starter plans include one published presence, an avatar, a clone of your own voice, text and audio conversations, products, and social connections. Current prices and limits are shown in Billing & plans.
plans.question: What is included in Bigmelo plans?

products.answer: Open Profiles, select the profile, and go to Products. If the feature is not enabled, activate it first under Settings. Select Add product, upload an image, enter the name and description, choose whether the destination is a store link, WhatsApp, or Telegram, and set the status to Public. Save the product and enable Use products in conversations. Only public products can be shown and recommended when relevant to a visitor's question. You can also upload multiple products from a CSV file.

socialNetworks.answer: You can do this in two ways. To display simple links on your public profile, open Profiles, select the profile, go to Data, and add each network with its URL under Networks; then save your changes. For a full integration, go to Integrations and select Instagram, TikTok, or YouTube. Connect the account or add the channel, sync or add its content, select the posts or videos you want to use, and add a description or notes. Depending on enabled features, selected content can be displayed and used as context in conversations.

trial.answer: Yes. You can start a seven-day trial with reduced limits. A payment method is required, and the plan is charged when the trial ends unless you cancel first.

docs.completionHelp: Stop requesting input when finished is true or status is completed, abandoned or failed.
docs.conversationExampleHelp: After starting, use the same conversation_id and session for every message. This example shows how your UI accumulates the conversation even though each response only returns the current advance.

endpoint.message: Sends a visitor message. data.messages contains one or more assistant messages generated by that flow advance.
endpoint.start: Creates a conversation pinned to the currently published flow. Keep conversation_id and session; data.messages contains the greeting or first instruction.
endpoint.status: Returns the current state without advancing the flow. This response has no messages property and does not return history.
endpoint.widget: Returns the enabled widget appearance for this key. It does not start a conversation.

fields.conversation_id: Conversation UUID. Place it in the URL for subsequent messages and status requests.
fields.fields: Form-ready definitions: stable key, translated label, HTML type, and required. Use this array instead of interpreting message text.
fields.finished: When true, the client must disable new messages and display the conversation as finished.
fields.locale: Active conversation language: es or en. It is also included in each assistant message.
fields.messages: Array of assistant messages created only during that request. It is not the complete history and may contain more than one message.
fields.optional_fields: Array included within the message with fields the UI should display but may submit empty without blocking the flow.
fields.required_fields: Array included within each message that requests data. It contains the identifiers the visitor must still provide.
fields.session: Encrypted token returned only when starting. Send it afterward in X-Bigmelo-Business-Session.
fields.status: Conversation state: in_progress, completed, abandoned, or failed.

docs.internalSolution: The AI-generated possible solution is internal: it is stored with the lead and sent to the business, but never appears in data.messages for the visitor.
docs.languageExampleHelp: Send locale when starting and with every message. The API stores the latest language and returns content and field labels in it; you can switch between turns without creating another conversation.
docs.localeHelp: Do not translate content in the frontend. Send locale as es or en and render content and fields[].label exactly as returned by the API.
docs.multipleMessagesNote: Important: data.messages is not the history. Append those entries in order. required_fields blocks progress; optional_fields is displayed but may be left empty.
docs.referenceHelp: The examples show the request body and the complete successful response your implementation should process.
docs.responseGuideHelp: Not every property appears in every endpoint. Pay particular attention to session, locale, messages, fields, required_fields, optional_fields, and finished.
docs.security: The Origin header must match an allowed origin. Keep the conversation session and send it on every message and status request.
docs.subtitle: Runtime API contract for your own chatbot or the included widget.
docs.terminalInstruction: An instruction with Finish chat is terminal: its message is returned in data.messages and that same response returns status completed and finished true. It does not need an outgoing arrow.
docs.title: Business chatbot API

turns.complete: Once the data is complete, the conversation ends and no more messages should be sent.
turns.missing: A required field is missing and the assistant identifies it precisely.
turns.name: The visitor provides their name and receives the next question.
turns.problem: The visitor describes the problem and the flow asks for contact details.

errors.generic: The Business request could not be completed.

flow.aiInstructionHelp: Describe what the AI should communicate or ask. The message will adapt to the conversation's current language and context.
flow.aiMessageHelp: AI will generate the visitor-facing message from this instruction. Manual messages are preserved and used as fallback if generation fails.
flow.decisionQuestionHelp: AI returns yes, no, or unclear by interpreting the latest response against the previous question. If unclear, it asks for clarification without selecting a branch.
flow.finishChatConnectionHelp: This is a terminal block and does not need an outgoing connection.
flow.finishChatHelp: This instruction will be the final message. The API responds with status completed and finished true without waiting for another visitor reply.
flow.instructionRequiredFieldsHelp: Comma-separated identifiers. They are returned in messages[].required_fields while still missing.
flow.instructionOptionalFieldsHelp: Comma-separated identifiers. They are shown in the form but do not block progress when left blank.
flow.messagesHelp: These manual messages are always preserved. They are used when AI generation is off or as fallback if it fails; an empty translation uses the available message.
flow.navigationHelp: Drag the canvas background to pan horizontally and vertically. Drag blocks to arrange them. To change a connection, click its arrow and drag the dot at its tip onto another block.
flow.neverPublishedWarning: The flow is saved but has not been published yet. Publish it so the chatbot can use it.

godaddy.description: A practical example for domains managed in GoDaddy. Menu names may vary slightly by country or panel version.
godaddy.note: Do not use domain forwarding or masking. Bigmelo needs a real DNS record to validate the domain, issue the HTTPS certificate, and renew that certificate automatically.

steps.add: Select Add New Record and choose CNAME. If you are connecting the apex domain, GoDaddy does not support a CNAME at @; use a subdomain such as profile.yourdomain.com or a provider that supports ALIAS/ANAME.
steps.conflicts: Before saving, remove only another A, AAAA, or CNAME record with the exact same Name. Do not remove MX, TXT, or email records.
steps.name: In Name, enter only the subdomain portion. Example: for bigmelo.abeldev.com inside the abeldev.com zone, enter bigmelo. The domain currently configured is {{hostname}}.
steps.open: In GoDaddy, open My Products, select your domain, open DNS, and then Manage DNS.
steps.target: In Value or Data, paste this exact target without http://, https://, or spaces: {{value}}
steps.ttl: Keep the default TTL or select 1 hour.
steps.verify: Save the record, wait for propagation, and return to Bigmelo. Select Verify configuration until the status is Active.

sampleScript.part1: Hello, thank you for listening. I am going to read this text with a calm, natural, and steady voice. I want this sample to capture the way I normally speak, with clear pauses between ideas and clean pronunciation. If a word sounds difficult, I will read it slowly instead of rushing, so the system can recognize my tone correctly.
sampleScript.part2: When I speak with someone, I try to keep a friendly rhythm that is easy to follow. Some sentences will be short, and others will be a little longer, because a real voice changes energy depending on what it is saying. I will pause briefly at the end of each sentence and continue reading in a steady way.
sampleScript.part3: I can also describe an everyday scene. Imagine a bright morning, a table with freshly served coffee, and an open planner with tasks for the day. The person reviews priorities, answers pending messages, and organizes time. Talking about simple situations helps capture different sounds, intonations, and word combinations with more variety.
sampleScript.part4: If I need to give an instruction, I would say it clearly. First review the main information, then confirm that the details are correct, and finally save the changes. This kind of reading has a more direct tone, but it should still feel close. I will keep my voice firm without shouting, and make every word easy to understand.
sampleScript.part5: Now I will keep reading continuously so the sample has enough duration. It is normal to breathe, make brief pauses, and continue naturally. I do not need to act or exaggerate the tone. I only need to speak as I would in a real conversation, keeping a comfortable distance from the microphone and avoiding bumps or sudden noises.
sampleScript.part6: To finish, I will close this sample with the same clarity I used at the start. This recording will help create a more accurate voice reference, so it is important to listen to the full audio before sending it. If I notice noise, cuts, or very low volume, I can record again and replace this sample.
